name: Solar PV Module
description: Converts sunlight into direct-current electrical energy.

name: Hybrid Inverter
description: Converts DC power to AC and manages grid, generator and battery sources.

name: Lithium Battery
description: Stores electrical energy for use when solar generation is low.

name: MPPT Charge Controller
description: Tracks the PV array operating point and regulates battery charging.

name: DC Isolator
description: Provides a means to isolate a DC circuit for safe maintenance.

name: AC Distribution Board
description: Houses protective devices and distributes AC circuits.

name: DC Circuit Breaker
specification: Voltage and current rating selected for circuit
description: Protects suitable DC circuits against overcurrent.

name: Surge Protection Device
specification: Type and rating selected by design
description: Limits transient overvoltage effects on connected equipment.

name: Solar Combiner Box
description: Combines PV strings and may house string protection devices.

name: Energy Meter
description: Measures electrical energy and related operating parameters.

name: Battery Management System
specification: Compatible with battery chemistry and voltage
description: Monitors battery cells and manages safe operating limits.

name: Earthing Electrode
specification: Selected to local code and soil conditions
description: Forms part of the installation earthing arrangement.

name: PV Cable
description: Connects PV modules and array components with suitable DC cable.

name: MC4-Compatible Connector
specification: Must match cable and connector manufacturer
description: Provides a compatible connection between PV cable sections.

name: Pure Sine Wave Inverter
description: Supplies AC power with a sinusoidal output waveform.
